findings.detail: A supplemental activity-table row for Production Resource Group was treated as a holding; its $111.0 million fair value explains the $110.9 million overshoot against the schedule total within rounding.

rationale: Class 3 aggregate flag. Raw anchors show total investments at fair value of $21,496.5 million in the schedule, while the extracted holdings sum is $21,607.4 million. The $110.9 million overshoot localizes to table 64 row 11, a supplemental activity table row headed by purchases/redemptions/income/gains and fair value, not a primary schedule-of-investments position; its $111.0 million fair value matches the residual within rounding.
